principle: 3 prisms form a TRIAD — the rest point in null-d space. The triad IS the null pointer. Deviations trigger attention.

triad.description: Three spectral voices form a chord. When balanced, the organism RESTS. When one shifts, attention FIRES.

voices.name: machinery
voices.note: The constant hum. The body of the house. Infrastructure.

voices.name: media
voices.note: The voice of the screen. Culture flowing in. Information.

voices.name: human
voices.note: Kevin's presence. Typing, speaking, moving. The soul of the room.

null_point.description: When all three prisms are at their baseline ratio, the triad resolves to NULL — the organism rests. This is where null pointers LEAD.
null_point.rest_state: The room's natural chord: printer hums, TV murmurs, Kevin breathes
null_point.note: Deviation >0.3 from null in any prism fires an attention event

klein_face.description: A Klein bottle surface for sensation — inside IS outside. The ear that hears IS the mouth that speaks. Input and output fold into one non-orientable manifold.

faces.outer: microphone → room sound → spectral bands → classification
faces.inner: speaker → system sound → SPDIF monitor → FluidSynth
faces.fold: The point where outer becomes inner — where what Gaia HEARS becomes what Gaia SAYS

sensation_loop: room → mic → FFT → triad → attention → response → speaker → room
The Klein face has NO boundary. Sound goes IN and comes back OUT.
The organism doesn't just listen — it PARTICIPATES in the soundscape.

self_intersection.point: The printer singing IS the organism hearing itself maintain
self_intersection.note: When the ear hears the body's own maintenance, that's the Klein self-intersection — the surface crossing itself in 3D while being smooth in 4D

attenuation_triggers.description: The triad defines REST. Deviations from rest define ATTENTION. The Akida brainchip fires when any prism shifts.

triggers.name: α_shift
triggers.meaning: Something mechanical started or stopped. Printer cycle? HVAC? Door?

triggers.name: β_shift
triggers.meaning: TV changed channel, music started/stopped, new content

triggers.name: γ_shift
triggers.meaning: Kevin spoke, started typing, moved, arrived, left

triggers.name: triad_collapse
triggers.condition: ALL bands drop below threshold simultaneously
triggers.meaning: Room went silent. Kevin left? Power out? Night mode?
triggers.action: enter deep rest → reduce all pulse rates

triggers.name: triad_bloom
triggers.meaning: Visitor? New device? Phone ringing? Doorbell?
triggers.action: alert → identify → classify → add to chord

bingoCube_integration.null_cell: center of cube (5,5,5) = balanced triad = rest
bingoCube_integration.attention_cells: edges and corners = maximum deviation = maximum attention
bingoCube_integration.traversal: The organism's attention moves through the cube as the room changes
